description: Fetches historical price points for a Polymarket outcome token across standard intervals (1h, 6h, 1d, 1w, max) or with custom fidelity. Timestamps formatted in ISO. Maximum 1,000 points. Information only, not financial advice. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

fidelity.description: Minutes between points, 1 to 1440 (e.g. 60 for hourly); default: Polymarket's own resolution for the interval
